description: This file defines the AutoFilter class used for handling auto-filtering in XLSX spreadsheets within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for loading and parsing auto-filter XML data, and creating filter rules for spreadsheet columns.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing and applying auto-filter XML data to spreadsheet columns, supporting standard, custom, dynamic, and top-ten filters.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the auto-filter data from the worksheet XML and initiates reading of auto-filter rules.

methods.name: readAutoFilter
methods.description: Parses auto-filter rules from a specified range and applies them to columns.

methods.name: readDateRangeAutoFilter
methods.description: Processes date range filter rules within the auto-filter XML.

methods.name: readCustomAutoFilter
methods.description: Handles custom filter rules, including AND/OR joins.

methods.name: readDynamicAutoFilter
methods.description: Processes dynamic filter rules such as today, tomorrow, etc.

methods.name: readTopTenAutoFilter
methods.description: Handles top ten/bottom filters with percentage or value options.
